pr_title: server: remove prepare stmt if no retry in stmt close()
pr_body:
Signed-off-by: wjhuang2016 <huangwenjun1997@gmail.com>

<!-- Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:
1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #20449 <!-- REMOVE this line if no issue to close -->

Problem Summary:
Prepare statement count doesn't decrease quickly.

### What is changed and how it works?

Call RemovePreparedStmt if doesn't need to retry.

### Related changes

- Need to cherry-pick to the release branch

### Check List <!--REMOVE the items that are not applicable-->

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- Unit test


Side effects

- Performance regression
    - Consumes more CPU
    - Consumes more MEM
- Breaking backward compatibility

### Release note <!-- bugfixes or new feature need a release note -->

- fix a bug that the count of the prepare statement doesn't decrease properly.
pr_comments:
> I think we could remove the txn retry feature to make the logic more simple.
> What do you think @coocood @tiancaiamao

+1

issue_context.title: Prep stmt can not deallocate when receiving `COM_STMT_CLOSE`  in the transaction.
issue_context.body: ## Bug Report Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks! ### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required) When using Mydumper to backup TiDB, the `Prepare Statement Count` will grow very high. I found that TiDB will not deallocate the ` Prep stmt ` when receiving `COM_STMT_CLOSE` in the transaction. Mydumper command ： `/mydumper/mydumper -h 172.16.4.138 -u root -P 4000 -t 16 -o ../backup_test_mydumper_pingcap/ -r 2000 -v 3 ` ### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required) Just like MySQL can deallocate the ` Prep stmt ` when receiving `COM_STMT_CLOSE` in transcation . ### 3. What did you see instead (Required) ### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required) ```sql MySQL [sbtest]> select tidb_version(); +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ | tidb_version() | +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ | Release Version: v3.0.19 Git Commit Hash: 7f2b1359a4829b571b1e7714088aebc216f6455a Git Branch: heads/refs/tags/v3.0.19 UTC Build Time: 2020-09-25 06:23:33 GoVersion: go version go1.13 linux/amd64 Race Enabled: false TiKV Min Version: v3.0.0-60965b006877ca7234adaced7890d7b029ed1306 Check Table Before Drop: false | +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ ```
